product_metadata.title: Buddeez Flour and Sugar Container - 4 Quart All Purpose Kitchen Organization and Storage Unit, Dry Storage Container For Kitchen, Large Food Storage Container for Organizing Your Pantry (White Lid)
features: Pantry Storage Container - This 5 lb flour storage container is multi-use and ideal for sugar, flour, rice, pasta, and more. Our flour container will save pantry space for other kitchen containers.
Dual-Use Flip Top Lid with Pour Spout - Our plastic container has a wide flip top lid, but also a handy built-in spout that is especially useful for pouring into small measuring cups and bowls.
Easy Grip Handle - The easy grip handle design makes it simple to pour and measure. Our multi-use pantry organization and storage container helps keep your pantry organized at all times.
Bag In Option - This clear storage container helps to easily identify your sugar and flour containers. The unique Bag-In storage option that keeps the container clean while preserving freshness.
Made in USA - Manufactured in the USA from the highest quality, BPA free resin and is top rack dishwasher safe. This dry food storage container will last for years. Dimensions 9 x 4.75 x 10 inch.
description: Buddeez Flour and Sugar Container - 4 Quart All Purpose Kitchen Organization and Storage Unit, Dry Storage Container For Kitchen, Large Food Storage Container for Organizing Your Pantry (White Lid) The Buddeez All Purpose organizers and storage units are ideal storage containers with lids for sugar, flour and more. The unique Bag-In function allows you to store in - and pour from - the original sugar bag, food containers, cereal boxes, coffee bags, which helps keep the container clean while preserving the freshness of the contents. Also, with the bag inside, you can always see through the cereal container and identify the brand and/or variety. Not to forget; the clever dual-use flip top lid, featuring 2 ways to pour! The handy flip-up spout allows neat and easy pouring into small bowls and measuring cups. Convenient multi-use containers for organizing pantry - This 4 quart capacity is a perfect coffee canister, flour canister, cat food storage container, rice storage container, brown sugar keeper, candy jar, food container, and more. Our sugar canisters hold up to 5 lbs and feature a strong EZ Grip handle to make handling of heavy contents a breeze and the dispenser’s rectangular shape fits snugly on your crowded shelves to help expand the available space in your pantry for your other coffee containers, snack containers. Bag-In storage option - To utilize this feature, simply place the bag inside the clear containers and scissor off the top of the bag or wrapper level with the container’s height. Replace the flip top lid so you can pour fresh from the original packaging! Storage + Organization: High quality engineering and attention to detail ensures years of trouble free service for this kitchen storage container. Other uses include: dry food storage, rice dispenser, sugar container, brown sugar container, cereal containers storage, container for flour, sugar storage, and more!
